scripts.lint: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.vercel.json && pnpm -r lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.vercel.json && pnpm --filter @bughunter/contracts build && pnpm --filter @bughunter/content build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: node scripts/validate-vercel-config.mjs && pnpm --filter @bughunter/contracts build && pnpm --filter @bughunter/content build && pnpm -r test
scripts.test:judge-content: pnpm --filter @bughunter/contracts build && pnpm --filter @bughunter/content build && pnpm --filter @bughunter/judge-worker validate:content
scripts.test:judge-api-content: pnpm --filter @bughunter/contracts build && pnpm --filter @bughunter/content build && node scripts/validate-api-content.mjs
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose logs -f api worker web
